bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
UW="$ROOT/.worktrees/userbot-report-20261115"
WT="$ROOT/.worktrees/bug-report-20261115"
test -d "$UW" && test -d "$WT" || exit 31
docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:bug-report-c2f6478 >/dev/null || exit 32
docker run --rm --entrypoint node gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:bug-report-c2f6478 --check /app/gaybbs.mjs >/dev/null || exit 33
docker run --rm --entrypoint sh gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:bug-report-c2f6478 -c 'grep -q "dm:bug:open" /app/gaybbs.mjs' || exit 34
systemctl --user is-active --quiet gace-userbot-verify.service || exit 35
state="$(systemctl --user show gace-public-video-only-nippon-20261115b.service -p ActiveState --value 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
if [ "$state" = active ]; then exit 72; fi
if [ "$state" = activating ]; then exit 73; fi
printf 'BUNDLE_CHECK=PASS\nUSERBOT_IDLE_FOR_MAINTENANCE=YES\n'
